identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload from a rare IP, then executes it. Cortex detects this behavior through recurring access to an uncommon external IP. The behavioral ABIOC flags repeated connections to such IPs.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: RecurringAccessToRareIP
biocs.description: Process accessing rare IP address multiple times within short period
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip in (select distinct action_remote_ip from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION group by action_remote_ip having count() < 5)
| filter timestamp > now() - 30m
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip, actor_process_image_name
| filter count() > 2
